sounds.prompt: A wax crayon scribbling quickly on paper, close up, no music, about 3 seconds.
A small family car engine idling then revving gently, recorded close up outdoors, no music, no voices, about 4 seconds.
A police car V8 engine idling with a deep burble, then a short rev, no siren, no music, about 4 seconds.
A huge monster truck engine rumbling at idle with a heavy low growl, then a big rev, no music, about 4 seconds.
A diesel school bus engine idling with a clattering diesel knock, no music, no voices, about 4 seconds.
A friendly toy police car siren going wee-woo wee-woo, two tones, bright and cheerful, not scary, no engine, no music, about 2 seconds.
sounds.note: Placeholder take until the owner picks one of the six.
